description: Returns a citation block for one obligation: status, effective date, instrument, article, penalty, primary source, amending act, evidence classification and the time the tense was computed. Use this when you are about to state a regulatory date or requirement to someone, so the claim carries its source.

id.description: Corpus id, e.g. "eu-art50". Use lunara_obligations to list them.

name: lunara_cite
title: Cite an obligation
